scope: Actual exported surface intersections and closed-volume signed clearance, with a retained closed anatomical body beneath the real exported garment shells. Open neck/cuff surfaces are used for visible intersections but never as a face-plane inside/outside test. Complete jerkin and shoulder yokes are checked against shirt/trousers. Harness and quiver suspension loops intentionally contact their contents/support and are separate materials; actual carried quiver, arrows, bow and belt map case are checked against all worn/exposed body surfaces.

falsePositiveDiagnostic.reason: Nearest open boundary face plane does not classify solid containment.
